title: How Do Anti-discrimination Laws Affect Firm Performance and Financial Policies? Evidence from the Post-World War II Period
eligible_reason: Staggered passage of state fair-employment laws (ad_law2) across 20 of 38 headquarters states between 1945 and 1963 (nine distinct adoption years inside the 1946-1964 panel), with 349 never-treated firms and 917 always-treated firms. Tables 4 and 6 report, for each of six outcomes, a first column with firm and year fixed effects and no controls (reghdfe Y ad_law2, a(cm_id fyear) vce(cluster cm_id)); Tables 5 and 7 each report a column that adds only beginning-of-sample firm characteristics interacted with year FE (time-invariant x time, allowed). The other columns add time-varying controls ($cont/$cont2) and/or state-specific linear trends and are excluded.
design_notes: Firm-year panel 1946-1964 (ad_dataset_ms1.dta, 13,646 rows) combining Compustat and hand-collected Moody's data; tsset cm_id fyear. ad_law2 = state AD law in force (time-varying by state; firm-level treatment via HQ state). Table 4: oibdp_atw, ni_atw, empgrw, each with (1) no controls, (2) $cont2 = ln_at_adj ppent_at div_payer state_inc_growth, (3) $cont2 + i.state_id#c.fyear. Table 5: oibdp_atw robustness with sic_2 x year FE + controls, census_division x year FE + controls, beginning-characteristics x year FE without controls (line 60), neighbouring-state AD law control. Table 6: lev_dlc_dltt_at, lev_lt_at, lev_mkt with (1) none, (2) $cont = ln_at_adj ni_at ppent_at div_payer state_inc_growth, (3) $cont + state trends. Table 7: leverage robustness analogous to Table 5 (beginning-characteristics x year column at line 115). Tables 8, 10-12: subsamples and RTW control, all with controls and state trends. Table 9: augmented sample (ad_dataset_ms2.dta) with ad_law_landes and enforce/non-enforce split, with controls and trends. All regressions reghdfe, cluster cm_id.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: State-level first year with ad_law2==1 inside the sample: 1946, 1947, 1950, 1955, 1956, 1957, 1959, 1961, 1963 (20 treated states; 18 never treated in sample). Firm-level first-treated years (from HQ-state assignment) spread over 1946-1963; 917 firms always treated (states with pre-1946 laws, e.g., NY/NJ 1945), 349 never treated, 386 switchers. ad_law2 is non-monotone for 0.2% of firms (likely HQ moves).
